provenance.prompt: Picking up the table and put on the bowl
provenance.source: Actual recorded in-distribution task data and existing task LoRA; new offline inference only, controlled shifted-guide experiment: right-hand guidance moved 10 cm along world X, observations unchanged. No training or robot execution.

selection.note: Controlled intervention on the previously selected training example; target translation is intentional. Original recording is reference only.

experiment.label: Controlled moved-bread target experiment
experiment.description: Right-hand guidance is translated toward a virtual target 10 cm along world X, ramped over the first five poses. Left-hand guidance and model observation inputs stay unchanged. Independent same-seed inference is rerun with 50% guidance. No physical bread relocation or robot execution.

target_distance_cm.definition: Euclidean distance from mean of five predicted right fingertips to the virtual target, at fixed future pose 7 (2.2 seconds). This is a landmark proxy, not contact accuracy or physical task success.
